preliminary_note: Computer-based 1:1 allocation with variable block length; assessor-blind parallel-group trial. Participant/deliverer blinding infeasible for exercise.
Randomized controlled study; intervention organized by canteen. Need full report to clarify allocation unit/concealment and whether clustering was handled.
Single-masked cluster-randomized trial among bank employees. Need full methods to identify who was masked and confirm allocation concealment/attrition analysis.

Random-number assignment performed by a research assistant not involved in recruitment; blinded outcome assessors/laboratory. Baseline groups similar. Attrition was 37%, and analysis was based on 43 completers rather than all 68 randomized participants.

Randomized intervention (37) and control (38) groups with baseline and 12-week assessment. Accessible report does not establish allocation concealment, assessor blinding, attrition handling, or analysis by randomized assignment.

Randomized pretest-posttest trial: 75 male office workers assigned 38 intervention/37 control. Remote Zoom-based programme. Concealment, assessor blinding, attrition and ITT details remain unclear from accessible report.
